# montecarlo_power_bi_credentials (Resource)

Power BI credentials are a Microsoft Entra ID app Monte Carlo signs in to Power BI with, as itself or as a user. The client secret or password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Entra ID app registration Monte Carlo signs in with.
- `auth_mode` (String) How Monte Carlo signs in. `service_principal` takes `app_client_secret`. `primary_user` takes `username` and `password`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant the Power BI service belongs to.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the app registration, for `service_principal`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `app_client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `app_client_secret_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `username`, for `primary_user`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `username` (String) User Monte Carlo signs in as, for `primary_user`.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
